summary: Juz'iyyah refers to the quality of being a part, portion, or division. It denotes particularity or the relation to a specific segment rather than the whole.
lane: [ جُزْئِيَّةٌ ذ The quality of relating to a part or portion or division; relation to a part &c.; particularity. ]

headwords.def: مَجْزُوْءٌ مجز مجزوء Divided into parts, or portions. (TA.) [ Having a part, or portion, taken from it: see 1.] A verse curtailed of two [ of the original ] feet: [like the هَزَج and مُضَارِع &c., which were originally of six feet each, but of which every known example is of four only:] or a verse consisting of two feet only: [as a kind of the رَجَز , and two kinds of the مُنْسَرِح : to each of which, or, accord. to some, to the former of which only, when thus consisting of only two feet, the term مَنْهُوكٌ is also applied:] the former is said to be عَلَى السَّلْبِ ; and the latter, عَلَى الوُجُوبِ . (TA.)
